nodes.summary: For a measure $\mu$ on an extended metric space $M$ equipped with a σ-algebra, the Hausdorff dimension of $\mu$ is the infimum, in $[0, \infty]$, of the Hausdorff dimensions of the measurable sets $s \subseteq M$ with $\mu(M \setminus s) = 0$.

nodes.title: Harmonic mean of Lyapunov exponents

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a measure on a measurable space $M$. A finite family $P$ of subsets of $M$ is a measurable partition of $M$ modulo $\mu$-null sets when every member of $P$ is measurable, the complement of the union of the members of $P$ has $\mu$-measure $0$, and any two distinct members $A \ne B$ of $P$ satisfy $\mu(A \cap B) = 0$.
nodes.title: Measurable partition modulo null sets

nodes.summary: For a map $T : M \to M$, a finite family $P$ of subsets of $M$ and $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the iterated join $\bigvee_{k=0}^{n-1} T^{-k} P$ is the finite family of all sets $\bigcap_{k=0}^{n-1} T^{-k}(A_k)$ with $A_0, \dots, A_{n-1} \in P$, where $T^{-k}(A)$ is the preimage of $A$ under the $k$-th iterate $T^k$. For $n = 0$ it is $\{M\}$.
nodes.title: Iterated join of a partition

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a measure on a measurable space $M$ and let $T : M \to M$ be a map. The Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy $h_\mu(T)$ is the supremum of the entropies $h_\mu(T, P)$ of $T$ relative to $P$ over all finite measurable partitions $P$ of $M$ modulo $\mu$-null sets, taken to be $0$ when these entropies are not bounded above.

nodes.summary: For a measure $\mu$ on a measurable space $M$ and a finite collection $P$ of subsets of $M$, the entropy of $P$ is $H_\mu(P) = \sum_{A \in P} -\mu(A) \log \mu(A)$, where $\log$ is the natural logarithm, with the convention $0 \log 0 = 0$. Here $\mu(A)$ is taken as a real number, so a set of infinite measure contributes $0$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
